outcome: Treatment success (disappearance of CSP mass, undetectable serum beta-hCG, and no serious complications)
cohort: 16 patients with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) treated with ultrasound-guided HIFU ablation between November 2011 and December 2012.
finding: Ultrasound-guided HIFU ablation was a successful, noninvasive, and effective treatment for CSP, with all patients achieving treatment success and experiencing minimal side effects.
